title: The Fantastic Case of the Missing Tesla
summary: The final chapter of Rich Rebuilds' saga about buying a used Tesla Model X that went missing, with cameo appearances and the end of the dispute. It is part of a longer series on the problems he had with Tesla.
why: HN recommends the series as a cautionary tale about buying used Teslas and dealing with Tesla service.

quote.text: Anybody involved with Tesla in any way should at least watch
